title: Act faster: hourly alerts for your critical flows, apps, and agents
summary: Spot performance and reliability issues sooner with hourly alerts in Monitor. By checking supported health metrics hourly instead of daily, these alerts help your team identify issues across apps, flows, and agents—and respond faster when thresholds are breached.
body_markdown:
A warehouse inventory app that slows down during a busy morning or an approval flow whose success rate begins to drop can quickly become a business concern. Hourly alerts in Monitor check supported health metrics for the resources you choose every hour instead of every day. Now, IT and Operations teams can keep a closer watch on the resources your business depends on.


For individual apps, flows, and agents, these new alert rules evaluate hourly metric aggregates and can fire when a configured threshold is breached. You get earlier awareness of changes in performance or success rates, helping you prioritize investigation and respond sooner to business-critical issues. This feature will be available as Public Preview in all commercial clouds by 11/20/26.


## Watch critical resources more closely


By default, Monitor metrics refresh every 24 hours, and alerts evaluate after the new 24-hour aggregates are produced. Set an alert rule’s **Data review period** to **1 hour** to enable hourly aggregation only for the selected metric on that resource. The rule evaluates after new hourly metrics are produced and can fire each hour when its condition is met.


Imagine a cloud flow that your service team relies on. If its success rate dips below a threshold you set, this alert can flag the change when the new hourly metrics are available. You can open the timeseries with hourly aggregates to see how the metric has shifted and decide where to investigate. These alerts enable you to move from a broad daily view to a more focused look at a resource your team depends on.


## Put hourly monitoring to work


Hourly alerts are available for Copilot Managed Runtime apps and supported Power Platform resources.


To create these alerts for **Copilot Managed Runtime** apps:


- Go to the Microsoft 365 admin center and click on **Apps** in the left navigation, and then **All Apps** .
- Within **All Apps,** find the app you want to create an alert on and click on it to bring out its details pane.
- Select the Monitor tab within the pane and then click on **+ New alert rule** .
- Choose a metric, and set the **Data review period** to **1 hour** .
- Configure the operator, threshold, severity and notification settings, then save the rule.


To create these alerts for supported **Power Platform resources** :


- Go to the Power Platform admin center and click on **Monitor** , choose a product, and select a resource to open its resource pane.
- Select **+ New alert rule** .
- Choose a supported metric, identified by a clock symbol in the metric selector, and set **Data review period** to **1 Hour** .
- Configure the operator, threshold, severity, and notification settings, then save the rule.


Make the rule reflect what matters to your business. A heavily used flow that supports a critical workflow may need a different threshold from a flow used less frequently.


*Configure an hourly alert for a selected resource and metric, using a threshold and notification settings that fit your needs.*


## Investigate with an hourly view


When an alert needs investigation, return to the same resource pane and selected metric chart. Set the chart’s Review period to **1 hour** to see hourly aggregates. The available chart time range is **24 hours** , giving you a full day of hourly history. The chart’s Review period and the rule’s Data review period are separate controls: one selects the view you investigate; the other configures the rule’s aggregation period.


The banner above the hourly timeseries shows that an alert fired within the displayed time range. Use it to connect alert activity to the trend on the chart. It is a historical signal, not confirmation that the alert is firing now, that an issue remains unresolved, or that an outage is ongoing.


The hourly chart adds detail without changing the surrounding summaries. The product list page and metric summaries on the left side of the resource pane continue to show 24-hour aggregates. Use the hourly chart to examine changes within that daily window.


*Review hourly metric history alongside a banner indicating that an alert fired within the displayed time range.*


## Choose your resource and metric


Pick the signal that best matches the resource and experience you want to monitor. Hourly alerts support the following product and metric combinations, and more will be supported in the future:


**Product** **Supported metrics**


Copilot Managed Runtime apps Time to interactive; App open success rate; App session count; Data request latency; Data request success rate


Canvas apps Time to interactive; App open success rate; Data request latency; Data request success rate


Model-driven apps App open success rate


Code apps Time to interactive; App open success rate; Data request latency; Data request success rate


Cloud flows Success rate


Agents Agent session success rate


## Start with your highest-priority resources


In the Power Platform, these alerts use the existing tenant-admin or environment-admin permissions and Managed Environment requirements for custom alerts. In the Microsoft admin center, Power Platform and Global admins can create and manage alert rules. Hourly refresh and evaluation are not real-time. These alert rules evaluate hourly once setup is complete and data is available.


### How many hourly alert rules can I create?


You can create up to 10 hourly alerts rules in each experience. The two admin centers have separate limits.


## What next?


Ready to take a closer look at a resource your business relies on? Open the Power Platform admin center ([Power Platform admin center](https://admin.powerplatform.microsoft.com/) ) or the Microsoft admin center ([Microsoft 365 admin center](https://admin.cloud.microsoft/#/homepage) ), choose a supported metric, and configure a rule with a 1-hour data review period and a meaningful threshold. Pair that rule with the hourly timeseries to focus your team’s next investigation and move from awareness to action.


Learn more: Go to[Create alerts for your resources – Power Platform | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/monitoring/alerts#monitor-critical-resources-with-low-latency-alerts-preview) for creating hourly alerts for Power Platform assets and[Monitor the health of apps in Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime (preview) – Microsoft 365 admin | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/admin/manage/apps/visibility-monitoring?view=o365-worldwide#create-alerts-for-your-apps) for creating alerts in the Microsoft admin center for Copilot Managed Runtime apps.
